_comment: Placeholder registry of MCP servers this harness WOULD connect to in production. The plant_tools.py mocks stand in for these today. To go live: stand up (or point at) each MCP server, then replace the corresponding mock in plant_tools.py with a Strands MCPClient that calls the server's tools. See https://strandsagents.com for MCP client wiring.

mes-oee.description: Manufacturing Execution System — OEE metrics, production counts, shift performance.

plc-historian.description: PLC/SCADA/historian access (OPC UA, Ignition, PI) — station telemetry, cycle times, torque, andon.

quality-mgmt.description: Quality-management / non-conformance system — defect records, containment, VIN linkage.

predictive-maint.description: Predictive-maintenance signals (AWS Monitron, IoT SiteWise, vendor platform).

erp-jit.description: ERP / supplier-portal (SAP, Oracle) — JIT parts supply, line-side inventory, ETAs.

mes-traceability.description: MES traceability / genealogy — per-VIN build records, torque events, station history (IATF 16949).

cmms.description: CMMS / EAM (SAP PM, IBM Maximo) for drafting maintenance work orders (human-approved).
